jurisdiction_name: NFLD VILL WARD A (NORTHFIELD VILLAGE Village)
narrative: Nfld Vill Ward A (Village of Northfield Village) has 562 registered voters, with 61.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 16.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 22.4%, a modest Democratic lean of 5.9 percentage points.
